text: Wages If the amount of total wages shown here is different from what you entered from your W-2(s), it may also include income entered or calculated elsewhere in your return. Other types of income that may be included in your total wages include: Tips you earned in your job that weren't included in your W-2 Taxable employer-provided dependent care benefits Disability income received before minimum retirement age (Form 1099-R) Reimbursements from your employer that exceed your expenses Moving reimbursements that exceed your expenses Income earned as a household employee Sick or disability payments Foreign-source wages Excess salary deferrals
